title: Normality of the extended geometric subgroup
as_he_states: Is T̂ν normal in Γν, for the pure peripheral groups of scans 89–90 andν≥2?

worth: High-value repair: a focused run can state the smallest extra marking and distinguish a stack from its finite geometric-class space.
